spec.description:
Autex Accent Ceiling Tiles (Solid Colour Ceiling Tiles) are a simple,
high-performance acoustic tile designed to drop directly into standard suspended
metric ceiling grids. Developed with two functional sides for design
flexibility, they feature a smooth classic white face and a vibrant solid colour
face selected from the Autex Cube palette. Made from 100% non-woven polyester
fibre containing a minimum of 80% recycled PET, they deliver an NRC of 0.85 and
Group 1 fire compliance without chipping, cracking, or breaking.
features:
Dual-sided functionality: solid colour face on one side and classic white on
the other

Engineered to drop directly into standard metric 600mm x 600mm
or 1200mm x 600mm ceiling grids

Delivers high acoustic sound absorption with
NRC 0.85 (Class A)

Lightweight, durable polyester that will not chip, crack,
or shed fibres

Supplied with a protective spun-bond cover to prevent soiling
during installation

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a
minimum of 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705
- 2003 and AS 5637.1

Resistant to moisture, mould, and mildew (ASTM G21-15
Growth Rating: 0)

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified
EPD
Available in over 20 contemporary solid Cube colours

install:
Ensure suspended ceiling grid is square, level, and properly
supported

Check that all tiles are supplied from a single production batch to
avoid colour variation

Tilt tile and gently lift upward through standard
metric 600x600 or 1200x600 ceiling grid opening

Select desired face
orientation (solid colour facing downward or classic white facing downward)
Lower tile squarely onto exposed grid tees without crushing edges

Remove the
protective spun-bond cover once the tile is safely seated in the grid

Where
perimeter cutting is required, cut neatly using a sharp utility knife and
straight edge
selection_checklist:
Confirm ceiling grid dimensions
(standard metric 600x600mm or 1200x600mm)

Choose face colour from Autex Cube
solid colour palette (20+ colours)

Verify batch numbers match across all
boxes to prevent dye-lot variation

Confirm target acoustic rating requires
Class A absorption (NRC 0.85)

Ensure compliance with NCC Group 1 fire rating
for commercial ceilings
accessories:
Standard two-way exposed ceiling
grid (15mm or 24mm tee)
limitations:
Designed specifically for standard metric suspended ceiling
grids
Indoor use only; avoid direct water exposure from overhead pipe leaks

Batch-to-batch colour variation can occur; do not mix batches in the same
space

use_cases:
Replacing fragile mineral fibre tiles in
school classrooms to improve speech clarity with durable, non-chipping tiles

Introducing corporate brand colours into commercial office suspended ceilings
while achieving Class A sound absorption

Acoustic ceiling upgrades in retail
environments and medical consulting rooms
not_for:
High-humidity swimming pool enclosures with direct water
splashing
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Solid Colour
Ceiling Tiles (Accent Ceiling Tiles) are durable 12mm drop-in acoustic tiles
designed for standard metric 600mm x 600mm and 1200mm x 600mm suspended ceiling
grids. Manufactured from 100% polyester fibre with over 80% recycled PET, they
feature a reversible design with a classic white face on one side and a choice
of 20+ solid colours on the other. Delivering Class A sound absorption
(NRC 0.85) and Group 1 fire compliance, they will not chip, crack, or release
respirable dust, making them an ideal acoustic and aesthetic upgrade for office,
education, and healthcare ceilings.
